title: Whole Life — America
north_star: A Prim is not a file format. A complete Prim system is an increasingly faithful, interconnected, actionable model of a human life.
formula: Life coverage = geometric_mean(breadth, depth, currency, connectivity, agency) × 100

grades.30: Shape of the system visible; life could not be reconstructed.
grades.70: Most ordinary questions answerable without organizing first.
grades.85: Notices important things before you do.
grades.100: Asymptotic — a living human never finishes.

breadth.why: 8 seed / 12 stub / 10 missing / 0 live of 30. Work, money dumps, calendar, people, digital, entities show the shape — most adulthood domains absent. 0.40 = shape visible, not half-covered.

depth.why: Unusually deep in companies/software/AI/docs; shallow or empty elsewhere. Depth concentrated ≠ depth across life. Vehicle/home/utilities earn almost nothing.

currency.why: Some harvests are fresh; continuous receive mostly in-host=no; whole domains never update.

connectivity.why: People graph incubating; almost no house→utility→card→service chains; records mostly isolated.

agency.why: Can read/search some packs; cannot yet operate the life (notice bill spike, file estate, run household).

score_interpretation: Enough of Daniel exists that the shape of the system is clearly visible (work, companies, digital infrastructure, calendar/people seeds), but nowhere near enough that Daniel's life could be reconstructed from it. Concentrated artifact volume in ~8 domains must not fake completeness.
